title: Glass Tide · Motion inside the image

clips.label: Repainting only
clips.note: All spatial transforms off. Watch the starburst patterns and small towers.
clips.details: Three seconds from the saved Glass Tide city painting. Constant original prompt, Krea 2 Turbo, Euler, noise 0.72, three updates, CFG 1, reference off. Each output feeds into the next repaint. No pan, zoom, roll, perspective or local deformation. RIFE 4.25 stays outside feedback; all 27 paintings retained. The model may still redraw objects or drift the composition.

clips.label: Repainting + local curl
clips.note: Same setup, with a curl around the patterned shelf on the right.
clips.details: Matched starting painting, constant prompt, seeds, noise and RIFE finishing. Adds one smoothly eased radial twist centered on the right shelf; influence decreases with distance. Global zoom and travel are zero. The deformation operates on the previous painting before each repaint. No mask or fixed-opening reference.
